note_en: 这样一来 means "this way" or "as a result," linking a method to its outcome: 这样一来，烤出来的肉才会色泽红亮 "that way, the roasted meat comes out a glossy red." Note the 才 after it: it stresses that the result only happens under that condition, something English expresses with "only then" or simply leaves implied.
